interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to naturally slow vehicle speeds and potentially reclaim space for a protected bike lane.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reducing the number of travel lanes to include a center turn lane or bike lanes would slow traffic and reduce the total crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Planted Buffer
interventions.description: Adding a continuous planted buffer or street furniture on the right side would provide better physical and psychological separation from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian refuge island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the road to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Adding a marked mid-block crosswalk with high-visibility 'continental' markings and pedestrian warning signs would provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk, potentially with a Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB).

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to facilitate safe crossing between commercial destinations.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing or Road Diet
interventions.description: Repurpose excess roadway width for bike lanes or wider buffers to naturally slow traffic speeds.

interventions.title: Dedicated Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Repurpose a portion of the wide roadway for protected bike lanes to narrow the travel lanes and provide a buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Removing parking spaces near potential crossing points to ensure clear sightlines between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a central refuge island to reduce crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a line of street trees or a furniture zone to create a physical and psychological buffer between the walkway and the travel lanes.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjusting signal timing to provide pedestrians with a head start before vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add a row of street trees or planters to provide a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and the street, improving perceived and actual safety.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crosswalk with high-visibility 'continental' markings to provide a safe crossing point for transit users.

interventions.title: Lane Striping
interventions.description: Add clear lane markings to organize traffic flow and potentially narrow travel lanes to encourage slower speeds.
